apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Settings panel (gear, top right): voice and speed, cues and volume, haptics, reminder times and quick-one cadence, which drills rotate, weight, export/import. Reminders no longer pop while the app is open.
Quick ones now run the whole exercise (all sets), not one set.

Lock screen shows the exercise, set and rep. Notification buttons: Start now / Snooze 20 min, and "Done already" on round reminders. A light tap on every rep phase. Calls and Siri pause the session and it resumes after. Screen stays awake during a session.
